If this is a one-time situation, it may be fine, but if it becomes a pattern without discussion, it could raise concerns about roles and expectations. 2. **Communication & Unity** – The Bible emphasizes unity in marriage (1 Corinthians 1:10) and mutual respect (Ephesians 5:22-25).
